title: Repair the derived counts and classification lists that the deletions invalidated
action: Three cascade failures from slice 2's deletions, all in derived counts and lists. (1) test_state_projection_race.mjs: cell vd-6 classified state.validation-cache.record and state.validation-cache.check into the verb buckets; cell vd-8 then deleted both verbs, so the suite now fails the OTHER direction -- 'classified verb(s) ... no longer exist in the manifest'. Remove both from whichever list holds them. Do NOT touch the five verbs vd-6 classified correctly. (2) test_onboard_bee.mjs: it asserts the source tree carries exactly 18 bee-* skills; bee-validating is deleted so the real count is 17. Update the expected count, and check whether the assertion names skills explicitly anywhere else. (3) test_doctrine_parity.mjs CRASHES with ENOENT on .agents/skills/bee-validating/CREATION-LOG.md -- it is reading a stale file list, most likely a .bee-render.json sidecar or an installed-mirror manifest that still names the deleted tree. Find what feeds it that path and make the list derive from what exists rather than from a stale record; a crash is worse than a failure because it hides every assertion behind it. Capture each failing run as before-evidence; author no probe scripts.

truths: node scripts/tests/test_doctrine_parity.mjs runs to completion without crashing and exits 0
The five verbs vd-6 classified are still classified the same way

artifacts.substantive: deleted verbs removed from the classification lists

key_links: the doctrine-parity file list derives from what exists on disk, not a stale manifest
prohibitions: No weakening of the coverage or parity assertions
No edit to skills/, AGENTS.block.md or packages/bee/lib/
